findings.detail: Two distinct Businessolver.com First Lien source rows collapse to the same duplicate position key when the drawn-status row label is not preserved.

rationale: B02 is an aggregate duplicate-key flag, but the raw June 30, 2024 schedule localizes the example duplicate to Businessolver.com, Inc.: row 4 is a regular First Lien position and row 5 is a separate First Lien - Drawn position, each with its own par, cost, and fair value. Collapsing both to one position key is therefore a real extraction/key-normalization error, not a source duplicate or a check-only false alarm.
